name: ESADE
summary: Private business and law school in Barcelona; four bachelor's and two double degrees taught in English on its Sant Cugat campus.

ib.text: Predicted 32/42 (core excluded) can be considered; admitted students average 36/42. IB maths required for business degrees. Esade test or SAT/ACT; UNEDasiss credential to enrol.

noDeadline: Rolling until June 2027 while places remain

programmes.name: Bachelor of Business Administration – BBA
programmes.about: A four-year business degree with compulsory internships and an optional exchange or dual programme in China or Canada; the English section is taught 100% in English.
programmes.ib: Apply to the English section (100% English); a bilingual section also runs. Maths AA SL 5 / HL 4, or AI HL 4 / SL 6.

needs.note: AA SL 5 or AA HL 4; AI HL 4; AI SL needs 6.

programmes.selectionNote: Holistic, rolling admission: IB record and predicted grades, the Esade test (or SAT/ACT) and essays, judged by committees every two weeks.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Business and Artificial Intelligence
programmes.credential: Bachelor in Business and Artificial Intelligence
programmes.about: Business fundamentals combined with rigorous technical training in machine learning, deep learning, generative AI and software for business; taught 100% in English.
programmes.ib: Maths AA SL 6, or AA HL or AI HL at 5.

needs.note: AA SL 6, or AA HL or AI HL at 5; AI SL is not listed.

programmes.selectionNote: Holistic, rolling admission: IB record and predicted grades, the Esade test (or SAT/ACT) and essays, judged by committees every two weeks.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Global Governance, Economics & Legal Order
programmes.about: International relations, economics and law taught entirely in English, with internships at international organisations and a Global Economics or Global Politics track.
programmes.ib: Maths studied at school is required only for the Global Economics track, not for Global Politics.
programmes.selectionNote: Holistic, rolling admission: IB record and predicted grades, the Esade test (or SAT/ACT) and essays, judged by committees every two weeks.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Transformational Leadership and Social Impact
programmes.about: Business and humanities for social impact, taught entirely in English, with a six-week class stay in Berlin in the second year.
programmes.ib: Maths AA SL 5 / HL 4, or AI HL 4 / SL 6.

needs.note: AA SL 5 or AA HL 4; AI HL 4; AI SL needs 6.

programmes.selectionNote: Holistic, rolling admission: IB record and predicted grades, the Esade test (or SAT/ACT) and essays, judged by committees every two weeks.

programmes.name: Double Degree Bachelor of Business Administration & Business and Artificial Intelligence
programmes.credential: BBA + Bachelor in Business and AI
programmes.about: Two official degrees in five years, taught entirely in English: a full business education plus advanced AI, for consulting, investment banking or tech roles.
programmes.ib: Maths AA SL 6, or AA HL or AI HL at 5.

needs.note: AA SL 6, or AA HL or AI HL at 5; AI SL is not listed.

notes: Admission can be revoked if your final IB score is more than 3 points below the minimum predicted grade Esade admitted you on.
Places are limited and committees meet every two weeks from September, so applying early in your final year matters.
The application fee is €150, non-refundable; Law and the Spanish-English double degrees are not taught fully in English.
